_comment: Small, fully-published gene sets that are quoted verbatim in their source papers.
Larger pathway sets are NOT stored here: they are downloaded from MSigDB by
scripts/00_fetch_resources.py so that the version is recorded and auditable.
Every entry carries its citation; if you add a set, add the citation too.

IFNG_Ayers6.citation: Ayers M et al. J Clin Invest 2017;127:2930-2940. PMID 28650338
IFNG_Ayers6.note: The 'refined' 6-gene IFN-gamma signature. Reported as an unweighted mean of normalised log expression in the source.

IFNG_Ayers_preliminary10.citation: Ayers M et al. J Clin Invest 2017;127:2930-2940. PMID 28650338
IFNG_Ayers_preliminary10.note: The 10-gene 'preliminary IFN-gamma' signature from the 19-patient melanoma pilot.

ExpandedImmune_Ayers18.citation: Ayers M et al. J Clin Invest 2017;127:2930-2940. PMID 28650338
ExpandedImmune_Ayers18.note: The 18-gene 'expanded immune' signature. This is NOT the same 18 genes as the T cell-inflamed GEP below - the two are routinely confused in the literature.

TcellInflamed_GEP18.citation: Ayers M et al. J Clin Invest 2017;127:2930-2940. PMID 28650338; Danaher P et al. J Immunother Cancer 2018;6:63 (Tumour Inflammation Signature, TIS)
TcellInflamed_GEP18.note: The clinical-grade T cell-inflamed GEP / NanoString TIS. The clinical assay uses a WEIGHTED sum on housekeeping-normalised NanoString counts; an unweighted ssGSEA score on RNA-seq is a proxy for it, not the assay, and its published -1.54 cut-off does not transfer.

CD8_Teffector_Mariathasan.citation: Mariathasan S et al. Nature 2018;554:544-548. PMID 29443960
CD8_Teffector_Mariathasan.note: CD8+ T-effector signature used to define the inflamed axis in IMvigor210.

Cytolytic_CYT_Rooney.citation: Rooney MS et al. Cell 2015;160:48-61. PMID 25594174
Cytolytic_CYT_Rooney.note: Cytolytic activity. Defined as the GEOMETRIC mean of GZMA and PRF1 in TPM (+1.0 offset), not an ssGSEA score. Use bulkimmune.signatures.cytolytic_activity().

TLS_12chemokine_Coppola.citation: Coppola D et al. Am J Pathol 2011;179:37-45. PMID 21703392
TLS_12chemokine_Coppola.note: The 12-CK score. Note the heavy overlap with the IFN-gamma signatures (CCL5, CXCL9, CXCL10): a 12-CK/IFN correlation is partly definitional, not biological.

TLS_Cabrita9.citation: Cabrita R et al. Nature 2020;577:561-565. PMID 31942071
TLS_Cabrita9.note: 9-gene TLS signature. WARNING: EIF1AY is Y-chromosomal, so this score is systematically lower in female patients regardless of TLS biology. Check the sex balance of your cohort, or drop EIF1AY and say so.

TLS_Cabrita9_noY.citation: Cabrita R et al. Nature 2020;577:561-565, with the Y-linked EIF1AY removed
TLS_Cabrita9_noY.note: Sex-neutral variant of the Cabrita signature. Report both if your cohort is sex-imbalanced.

Bcell_follicular.citation: Composite of the B-cell/follicular-DC markers used to call TLS histologically (Sautes-Fridman C et al. Nat Rev Cancer 2019;19:307-325).
Bcell_follicular.note: Descriptive marker set, not a validated predictive signature. Included to sanity-check the TLS scores against B-cell content.

MHC_class_I.citation: Antigen-presentation machinery; NLRC5 as the MHC-I transactivator (Meissner TB et al. PNAS 2010).
MHC_class_I.note: Loss of this axis is a canonical resistance mechanism and a useful covariate when interpreting exclusion scores.
